blocks.instruction: Look at the following statements and the list of people below. Match each statement with the correct person, A–E. You may use any letter more than once.

people.name: Owen Kariuki
people.role: Site manager at Northgate Distribution who leads the final interviews

people.name: Dev Sandoval
people.role: Former picker, now night team leader in the ambient section

people.name: Mirjam Tanaka
people.role: Training lead who runs the induction for new team leaders

people.name: Yara Bellamy
people.role: Recruitment coordinator who organises the assessment day

people.name: Luka Petrović
people.role: Health and safety officer on the assessment panel

paragraphs.text: Northgate Distribution is looking for eight team leaders to join its regional centre in Halbrook. Over the next year the site will open a new chilled section for fresh food, which means more orders, more vehicles and more people on every shift. Successful applicants will each be responsible for a team of between twelve and fifteen warehouse operatives, working either a day pattern (6 a.m. to 2 p.m.) or a night pattern (10 p.m. to 6 a.m.). Both are permanent, full-time positions, and the starting salary is reviewed after the first six months.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: So what does the job actually involve? According to site manager Owen Kariuki, it is less about giving orders than people imagine. 'A good team leader isn't someone who walks around with a clipboard,' he says. 'They start every shift with a short briefing, share out the work fairly, keep an eye on accuracy and sort out problems before they grow.' When someone calls in sick or a delivery arrives late, the team leader decides how to move people around so that orders still leave on time. Owen adds that the quality he values most is the ability to stay calm when things go wrong. 'I'd much rather have someone who owns up to a mistake straight away than someone who hides it until the end of the shift.'
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: You do not need to have held the title of supervisor before. We ask for at least one year's experience in a warehouse, retail or delivery setting, along with good spoken and written English and basic computer skills. A forklift licence is useful but not essential, since we can arrange the training. Current Northgate employees are encouraged to apply. Dev Sandoval, who joined as a picker four years ago and now leads the night team in the ambient section, says the biggest adjustment was not the paperwork but the relationships. 'Suddenly I was giving feedback to people I'd been having lunch with the week before. You have to be fair to everyone, including your friends.'
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: New team leaders are not left to work things out alone. Training lead Mirjam Tanaka runs a six-week induction that begins with a fortnight of shadowing, during which each newcomer works alongside an experienced leader on the same shift pattern they will later take over. This is followed by a short course on coaching and handling difficult conversations. 'People often assume the system is the hard part,' Mirjam says, 'but most can learn the stock software in a few days. Listening well takes longer.' Night-shift leaders receive an additional allowance, and all staff have access to a pension scheme and a subsidised canteen.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an assessment day at the Halbrook site. Recruitment coordinator Yara Bellamy explains that it lasts about four hours and has three parts: a guided tour of the warehouse floor, a group exercise and a one-to-one interview. 'Please bring photo ID and proof of your right to work in the UK,' she says. 'For the tour you must wear closed-toe shoes. If you don't own safety boots, tell us your size in advance and we'll lend you a pair.' Candidates who arrive late may not be able to join the tour, because groups leave reception on the hour.
paragraphs.label: E

paragraphs.text: In the group exercise, candidates are given a realistic problem, such as planning a shift when three operatives are absent and a large order has just come in. Yara stresses that the assessors are not looking for the loudest voice in the room. 'We notice who listens, who checks that quieter people have had their say, and who keeps an eye on the clock.' Health and safety officer Luka Petrović also sits on the panel. He pays particular attention to whether candidates raise safety without being prompted. 'On the tour, I'm interested in people who spot a blocked fire exit or a pallet stacked too high and mention it. That tells me more than any answer they've rehearsed.'
paragraphs.label: F

paragraphs.text: The final interview is usually led by Owen himself. He asks every candidate to describe a real occasion when a plan fell apart and what they did next, so it is worth preparing two or three examples from your own working life. Dev's advice is simple: 'Be honest about what you'd do differently now.' To apply, complete the online form by 28 March. If you need any adjustments for the assessment day, contact Yara directly before you attend.
paragraphs.label: G

section.text:
Team Leaders Wanted at Northgate Distribution

A. Northgate Distribution is looking for eight team leaders to join its regional centre in Halbrook. Over the next year the site will open a new chilled section for fresh food, which means more orders, more vehicles and more people on every shift. Successful applicants will each be responsible for a team of between twelve and fifteen warehouse operatives, working either a day pattern (6 a.m. to 2 p.m.) or a night pattern (10 p.m. to 6 a.m.). Both are permanent, full-time positions, and the starting salary is reviewed after the first six months.

B. So what does the job actually involve? According to site manager Owen Kariuki, it is less about giving orders than people imagine. 'A good team leader isn't someone who walks around with a clipboard,' he says. 'They start every shift with a short briefing, share out the work fairly, keep an eye on accuracy and sort out problems before they grow.' When someone calls in sick or a delivery arrives late, the team leader decides how to move people around so that orders still leave on time. Owen adds that the quality he values most is the ability to stay calm when things go wrong. 'I'd much rather have someone who owns up to a mistake straight away than someone who hides it until the end of the shift.'

C. You do not need to have held the title of supervisor before. We ask for at least one year's experience in a warehouse, retail or delivery setting, along with good spoken and written English and basic computer skills. A forklift licence is useful but not essential, since we can arrange the training. Current Northgate employees are encouraged to apply. Dev Sandoval, who joined as a picker four years ago and now leads the night team in the ambient section, says the biggest adjustment was not the paperwork but the relationships. 'Suddenly I was giving feedback to people I'd been having lunch with the week before. You have to be fair to everyone, including your friends.'

D. New team leaders are not left to work things out alone. Training lead Mirjam Tanaka runs a six-week induction that begins with a fortnight of shadowing, during which each newcomer works alongside an experienced leader on the same shift pattern they will later take over. This is followed by a short course on coaching and handling difficult conversations. 'People often assume the system is the hard part,' Mirjam says, 'but most can learn the stock software in a few days. Listening well takes longer.' Night-shift leaders receive an additional allowance, and all staff have access to a pension scheme and a subsidised canteen.

E. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an assessment day at the Halbrook site. Recruitment coordinator Yara Bellamy explains that it lasts about four hours and has three parts: a guided tour of the warehouse floor, a group exercise and a one-to-one interview. 'Please bring photo ID and proof of your right to work in the UK,' she says. 'For the tour you must wear closed-toe shoes. If you don't own safety boots, tell us your size in advance and we'll lend you a pair.' Candidates who arrive late may not be able to join the tour, because groups leave reception on the hour.

F. In the group exercise, candidates are given a realistic problem, such as planning a shift when three operatives are absent and a large order has just come in. Yara stresses that the assessors are not looking for the loudest voice in the room. 'We notice who listens, who checks that quieter people have had their say, and who keeps an eye on the clock.' Health and safety officer Luka Petrović also sits on the panel. He pays particular attention to whether candidates raise safety without being prompted. 'On the tour, I'm interested in people who spot a blocked fire exit or a pallet stacked too high and mention it. That tells me more than any answer they've rehearsed.'

G. The final interview is usually led by Owen himself. He asks every candidate to describe a real occasion when a plan fell apart and what they did next, so it is worth preparing two or three examples from your own working life. Dev's advice is simple: 'Be honest about what you'd do differently now.' To apply, complete the online form by 28 March. If you need any adjustments for the assessment day, contact Yara directly before you attend.

explanation.uk: В абзаці A пояснюється, що на складі відкриється нова ділянка для свіжих продуктів — «chilled section», і це принесе більше замовлень і потребуватиме більше людей.

explanation.uk: В абзаці B Owen Kariuki каже, що керівники команд починають кожну зміну з короткого інструктажу.

questions.prompt: As well as a year's relevant experience and good English, applicants need basic ______.
questions.evidence: good spoken and written English and basic computer skills

explanation.en: Paragraph C lists the requirements: experience, good spoken and written English, and basic computer skills.
explanation.ru: В абзаце C перечислены требования: опыт работы, хороший устный и письменный английский и базовые навыки работы с компьютером.
explanation.uk: В абзаці C перелічено вимоги: досвід роботи, добра усна й письмова англійська та базові навички роботи з комп’ютером.

questions.prompt: Having a ______ is an advantage, but it is not required because the company can provide the training.
questions.evidence: A forklift licence is useful but not essential, since we can arrange the training

explanation.en: Paragraph C says a forklift licence is useful but not essential. 'An advantage, but not required' restates 'useful but not essential'.
explanation.ru: В абзаце C сказано, что права на погрузчик полезны, но не обязательны. «An advantage, but not required» — это перефразированное «useful but not essential».
explanation.uk: В абзаці C сказано, що посвідчення водія навантажувача корисне, але не обов’язкове. «An advantage, but not required» — це перефразоване «useful but not essential».

questions.prompt: The induction opens with two weeks of ______, when newcomers work next to an experienced leader.
questions.evidence: a six-week induction that begins with a fortnight of shadowing

explanation.en: Paragraph D says the induction begins with a fortnight (two weeks) of shadowing an experienced leader.
explanation.ru: В абзаце D говорится, что вводное обучение начинается с «fortnight» (двух недель), в течение которых новичок работает рядом с опытным руководителем и наблюдает за ним.
explanation.uk: В абзаці D йдеться про те, що вступне навчання починається з «fortnight» (двох тижнів), протягом яких новачок працює поруч із досвідченим керівником і спостерігає за ним.

questions.evidence: Night-shift leaders receive an additional allowance

explanation.en: Paragraph D states that night-shift leaders receive an additional allowance. The pension and canteen are for all staff, not only night workers.
explanation.ru: В абзаце D указано, что руководители ночных смен получают дополнительную надбавку. Пенсия и столовая положены всем сотрудникам, а не только тем, кто работает ночью.
explanation.uk: В абзаці D зазначено, що керівники нічних змін отримують додаткову надбавку. Пенсія та їдальня передбачені для всіх працівників, а не лише для тих, хто працює вночі.
